name: Density Reconstruction via Differentiable Rendering
aliases: Density Reconstruction via Differentiable Rendering — Density Field Update
definition: The process of reconstructing the density field by computing loss against target/primal images, reading density gradients from recorded sampling positions, updating voxel values, and releasing memory.
summary: Density Reconstruction via Differentiable Rendering updates volumetric density by scattering pre-recorded gradients to voxels, avoiding separate backward passes or forward recomputation.
